aboutPage.title: About Bornaal
aboutPage.missionDesc: Bornaal was born with a simple mission: connect people who need services with trusted providers in Guinea-Bissau. We believe everyone deserves easy access to qualified professionals, without middlemen or hassle.
aboutPage.visionDesc: We want to become the leading service platform in Guinea-Bissau, boosting the local economy and creating opportunities for providers across the country. We value transparency, trust and community.
aboutPage.step1: Search by category or location to find providers.
aboutPage.step2: Contact directly via WhatsApp or internal message.
aboutPage.step3: Rate the service and help the community grow.

termsPage.title: Terms of Use
termsPage.s1Desc: By using Bornaal, you accept these terms in full. If you disagree, please stop using the platform.
termsPage.s2Desc: Bornaal is a platform connecting clients and service providers in Guinea-Bissau. We are not party to any transaction, acting only as a digital intermediary.
termsPage.s3Desc: Users must provide truthful, up-to-date information. One account per person. You are responsible for your account security and password.
termsPage.s4Desc: You agree not to post false, offensive or illegal content. Reviews must be honest and based on real experiences. Spam and fraud are prohibited.
termsPage.s5Desc: Bornaal is not liable for service quality, disputes between users, or damages from using the platform. Providers are independent professionals.
termsPage.s6Desc: All platform content, design, logos and texts belong to Bornaal. Users retain rights to content they publish.
termsPage.s7Desc: We may change these terms at any time. Changes take effect after publication. Continued use constitutes acceptance.
termsPage.s8Desc: For questions about these terms, contact us at bornaal.com@gmail.com.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.s1Desc: We collect information you provide directly: name, email, phone, location and service description (for providers). We also collect usage data like reviews and messages sent via the platform.
privacyPage.s2Desc: We use your information to create and manage your account, facilitate connections, display provider profiles publicly, send account notifications and improve our services.
privacyPage.s3Desc: Provider profiles are publicly visible including name, category, location, phone and reviews. We do not sell or share your personal data with third parties for commercial purposes.
privacyPage.s4Desc: We implement security measures to protect your information against unauthorized access. Data is stored on secure servers with encryption.
privacyPage.s5Desc: You have the right to access, correct or delete your personal data. You can request account deletion at any time by contacting us directly.
privacyPage.s6Desc: We use browser local storage to keep your session active. We do not use third-party tracking cookies.
privacyPage.s7Desc: For privacy questions, contact us at bornaal.com@gmail.com.
